items.text: kab milega
kal tak ho jayega
haan ji
abhi aayega kya
theek hai
thoda wait kar lo
jaldi batao
woh raat tak

items.context: Kya aapke order mein koi dikkat hai?
items.text: haan lekin delay hai
mera parcel abhi tak nahi mila hai
accha toh aap mujhe track kar ke batao
matlab kal tak deliver ho jayega
mera order kuch delay ho gaya hai shayad
haan ji wo Saturday ko aana tha
mera address sahi de diya tha main
wo Monday nahi Tuesday ko deliver hoga
meri payment confirm ho gayi hai na
accha abhi kitna time lagega batayein
mera parcel Mumbai se Jaipur jana tha
matlab mujhe phone par kaha gaya tha ki
thoda jaldi batao mein intezar kar raha hu
par mera order update nahi hua hai
mera naam Anil Kumar hai aur order number 54321 hai

items.context: Kya aapne apne order ko track kiya hai?
items.text: haan abhi tak tracking update nahi dikh raha

items.context: Kya aap chahenge main aapko delivery ka time estimate doon?
items.text: toh mujhe approximate delivery time batao

items.context: Aapko delivery kis din expected thi?
items.text: wo Wednesday tha nahi Tuesday ko deliver hoga

items.context: Kya aap jaante hai ki aapka order kaha hai abhi?
items.text: matlab mera order abhi transit mein hai

items.context: Kya aapko apni delivery ko leke koi dikkat ho rahi hai?
items.text: par main thoda pareshaan ho raha hu ab
mera order Saturday ko place kiya tha lekin abhi tak delivery nahi hui hai mujhe pata karna hai ki kaha atka hua hai
main customer service se baat kar raha tha aur mujhe bola gaya tha ki kal tak order deliver ho jayega par abhi tak kuch update nahin aaya
kya aap please mera order number 12345 ko check kar ke bata sakte hain ki mera parcel abhi kaha hai matlab woh delivery ke liye tayar hai ya nahi

items.context: Kya aap mujhe apne order ke status ke baare mein bata sakte hain?
items.text: maine order place kiya tha last week par tracking mein abhi tak koi update nahi dikh raha hai kya aap madad kar sakte hain is baare mein

items.context: Aapka order kahan se kahan deliver hona tha?
items.text: mera naam Rahul hai aur mera parcel Delhi se Chennai jana tha lekin mujhe lag raha hai ki wo abhi tak dispatch nahi hua hai kya aap confirm karenge

items.context: Order delivery date ke baare mein aapko kya pata hai?
items.text: kya aap mujhe bata sakte hain ki mera order Tuesday ko aana tha ya Wednesday ko kyunki mujhe confuse ho raha hai main apni schedule set karna chahta hu

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: where_is_order - asks where their order or parcel is
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
